messages:
jamie: Quick status check on Stallion on-prem cutover. Are we green for the week-of 2026-06-15 window? Need final go/no-go by EOD tomorrow.

tara: On networking: egress NAT and firewall rules are in staging, waiting for security sign-off. Added the rule set to the runbook: `allow 10.0.0.0/16 -> 52.23.12.0/24:443` :white_check_mark:

miguel: Image syncs completed for airgapped nodes. Two images failed signature verification, raising to CI. @rachel can you triage the image signing failures?

rachel: On it, pulling logs now. Suspect GPG key rotation hit the signed-manifest. Will have PR by morning.

jamie: Who owns the KMS/HSM integration for this tenant? Need to confirm key policy before cutover.

tara: @miguel is on key management for Stallion. Miguel, confirm KMS ARNs and whether we need explicit cross-account roles.

miguel: Confirmed KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01. Need cross-account role; I created `redwood-stallion-kms-access`—pending infra-approval.

rachel: Security review flagged that `redwood-stallion-kms-access` needs least-privilege policy. I'll add a template and ping legal.

jamie: Any blockers on canary routing? We want to run 10% traffic for 2 hours then ramp.

tara: Canary target config ready. One nuance: the on-prem proxy doesn't support chunked streaming; we need fallback to non-streaming mode for canary. Patch submitted: `eng-platform#842`.

miguel: Also we need a host-level kernel param on stallion nodes: `vm.max_map_count=262144`. Ops runbook updated.

rachel: For the airgap fallback, we need a manual egress path via jumpbox if image fetch fails. Ops confirmed jumpbox IP: 34.201.99.18

jamie: @ops-bot can you schedule a pre-cutover smoke at 06:00 UTC day-of? :calendar:

ops-bot: scheduled smoke test for 2026-06-15T06:00:00Z, will post results to #incidents.

tara: Regarding threads and approvals — I still need the CR for firewall rule change in `infra/terraform` (PR #512). @miguel can you shepherd? Otherwise net team will hold.

miguel: On it. Will post a small diff and get netops approval today.

rachel: One more: audit logs retention for private deploy. Stallion wants 1 year. Storage impact is ~120GB/month. Finance ok? @linda FYI

linda: Finance reviewed, one-time allocation approved. Add to invoice for month-of-cutover.

jamie: Great. Action items:
- miguel: finish CR + KMS role (today)
- rachel: PR for image signing fix (tomorrow AM)
- tara: firewall PR follow-up + canary config (today)
- ops: schedule smoke + prepare jumpbox access docs
We'll reconvene async — please update PRs and the cutover checklist. :thumbsup:

miguel: Quick Q — who will own on-call for first 24h post-cutover?

tara: Eng-oncall rotation will cover day 0, customer success will shadow. I'll add owners in the runbook.

jamie: Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker, @jamie and @tara directly. :eyes:
